ops.text: A background Agent run with `isolation: 'worktree'` finished with uncommitted changes (its report even said "Nothing committed", per our no-commit lane discipline), and the harness deleted the worktree directory anyway — the tool doc says worktrees are "auto-cleaned if unchanged", but this one WAS changed and still vanished, leaving only a dangling `git worktree list` registration pointing at a branch equal to main. The deliverables had to be recovered by replaying the Write/Edit tool_use records out of the agent's transcript JSONL (worked, but only because the files were created via Write/Edit rather than shell redirection). Until the cleanup contract is fixed, worktree lanes must end by exporting their changed files somewhere durable (e.g. /tmp) or the orchestrator must copy files out before the completion notification is processed.
